material_conditions: Make and explain formal geometric constructions with compass/straightedge, string, reflective devices, folding or geometry software.

Examples include copying segments and angles, bisecting segments and angles, constructing perpendicular lines (including a perpendicular bisector), and drawing a parallel line through a point not on the given line.
Construct an equilateral triangle, a square and a regular hexagon inscribed in a circle.
Course bracket for G-CO.12–13: formalize and explain construction processes.
